requirement: Return one clinical metric as a read-only projection: identity, publication fields, the applied flag, and every live rule with its criterion formula plus either a rendered score function or the major/minor weight; a missing id is reported as ResourceNotFound.

preconditions.text: The requested clinical metric exists and is live
The metric carries the rules or criteria seeded for the case
One rule of the metric is soft-deleted
The requested id matches no live metric

inputs.text: Query for the five-rule CURB-65 metric
Query for a metric where one of two rules is soft-deleted
Query for a draft (not applied) metric
Query for a metric that has no rule
Query for a metric that was soft deleted beforehand
Query for the PSI metric whose rules mix constant, variable, and arithmetic score functions
Query for the IDSA/ATS metric with two major and two minor rules

returns.text: Success with the metric identity, publication fields, and applied flag
Every live rule is projected with its criterion name and rendered formula
Scoring rules carry a rendered score function and no major/minor flag
Major/minor rules carry only their weight and no score function
Failure with ResourceNotFound and a null payload

exception_text: No unhandled exception; a missing or soft-deleted metric is returned as a failed Result
